title: A man falls from a hotel window on Telegraph Avenue

tellings.quote: >> Because when I look up three stories up there's an open window with a curtain blowing and they jumped.

plain: Brent Friedman, a Hollywood screenwriter, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something he says he saw in the late 1970s on Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley, California. He says he looked up three storeys at a hotel, saw an open window with a curtain blowing, and realised someone had just jumped or fallen from it. He tells it as part of his own story about how he came to the subjects of Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs.
